svg.aria-label: Unconventional Moves, an LLM skill. It turns a constrained goal into five to seven practical approaches that work through different mechanisms, then picks one small experiment that can begin within 48 hours. Shown as several curved paths from a start to a goal beside the ordinary straight one; a probe runs out along one path to a checkpoint and comes back.

g.text: Five to seven approaches through different
